subject: Spike in errors & p99 after model upgrade — SLA risk
messages:
From: Jason Leung <jason.leung@skylineretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: sre@skylineretail.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:14:00 +0000
Subject: Sudden spike in 5xx & p99 after yesterday's update

Hi Kimberly —

We started seeing a spike in 5xx rate and p99 inference latency starting ~08:30 PST yesterday, right after the model version swap you completed. Our checkout flows are timing out for a subset of users. We captured a bunch of error snippets and a latency chart (attached). This is hitting our SLA and our ops team is fielding alerts non-stop.

Can you confirm whether anything in the rollout could have caused this? We need an immediate mitigation plan — either a rollback or a configuration fallback.

Jason
Director of Engineering
Skyline Retail

Attachments: skyline_error_snippets.txt (text), p99_latency_charts.png (image)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Leung <jason.leung@skylineretail.com>
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sudden spike in 5xx & p99 after yesterday's update

Jason — thanks for flagging and for the attachments. Really sorry you're seeing this.

We're investigating now with engineering and ops. Quick notes:
- I see Skylines's requests were routed to the new v2.3-quant profile at ~08:20 PST during an automated rollout.
- We will prioritize either a hot rollback to the prior runtime profile or a targeted routing policy to steer Skyline traffic to the pre-upgrade model until we confirm root cause.

Requesting permission to execute an immediate traffic rollback for Skyline to v2.2 (previous stable) and to open an incident page with the team. Mateo/Evelyn: can you confirm contract credits language if we need to offer a goodwill credit? Jonas: can you triage the quant profile differences?

I will set up a short bridge and keep you updated every 30 mins.

—Kimberly
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sudden spike in 5xx & p99 after yesterday's update

Kimberly — initial triage:

- We rolled out a new quantization profile (a aggressive per-tensor 4-bit config) to reduce cost. On the short tests it looked fine, but in production we see a higher variance in per-request latency for long-context requests.
- Error stack traces in the snippets point to occasional KV cache lookup misses causing retries that cascade into 5xx for large-batch checkout requests. The miss rate is ~0.6% which normally would be fine, but combined with longer tail latency it's pushing some requests over the timeout threshold.

Mitigation options (ranked):
1) Immediate rollback to v2.2 (pre-quant) for Skyline — fastest to restore SLA.
2) Narrow rollback: route only Skyline's high-rate endpoints to v2.2 while keeping lower-sensitivity flows on v2.3-quant. Requires policy change and testing (~45–75m).
3) Adjust quant profile parameters to relax per-tensor packing (risky, needs full validation).

I can prepare rollback plan and run it with ops. Will attach proposed rollback_plan_v1.pdf shortly.

—Jonas
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Runtime
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jason Leung <jason.leung@skylineretail.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 17:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sudden spike in 5xx & p99 after yesterday's update

Jason — apologies for the disruption. We own this and will move quickly.

Contracts note: Skyline is on an enterprise plan (SKY-ENT-0921) with a 99.9% inference SLA. If we cannot restore within the next 12 hours, standard practice is to offer a pro-rated credit for SLA miss; for material customer impact we typically propose a 1–2 week service credit as a gesture of goodwill depending on severity. Evelyn/Marissa — please advise on the comms approach; I'll defer to you on exact credit wording.

Proposed immediate action: execute Jonas's top option (full rollback) and keep Skyline on v2.2 until we validate a safe quant profile. Kimberly — please confirm we have approval to run rollback now.

—Mateo
Account Director, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jason Leung <jason.leung@skylineretail.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 02:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sudden spike in 5xx & p99 after yesterday's update

Team — authorized rollback approved.

Action plan (executive summary):
- 02:15 UTC: Ops will execute rollback to v2.2 for all Skyline production traffic (Jonas/ops).
- 02:30 UTC: Monitor p50/p95/p99 and 5xx rate; we will hold until p99 returns to baseline for 30 mins.
- 03:15 UTC: If stable, open postmortem and begin root cause timeline.

Jason — I am looping in Marissa and Evelyn for formal comms and any credit discussion. Expect a short update at +30m.

—Kimberly
From: Jason Leung <jason.leung@skylineretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 23:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sudden spike in 5xx & p99 after yesterday's update

Kimberly / team — thanks for the rapid response. Confirmed: rollback completed and p99 is back within SLA for the last 45 minutes. Our monitoring shows 5xx rate dropped from 1.8% to 0.02%.

Next asks from Skyline:
- Shared timeline of the planned quant profile validation before reintroducing v2.3-quant (they asked for test-suite and perf guardrails).
- Formal incident postmortem and any customer credits (we understand contract terms but want good will).

Please let me know when the postmortem doc is available.

—Jason
